title: NST Textbook Escrow
idea: Peer-to-peer textbook exchange for NST Pune students with UPI escrow and ISBN barcode scanning to ensure book condition before payout release.

title: Campus Shuttle Tracker
idea: Real-time crowdsourced shuttle tracking connecting college gates to remote hostel blocks with live ETA predictions.

title: Medical Drone Dispatch
idea: Autonomous drone dispatch coordinator that routes critical antivenom and emergency blood packs between rural primary healthcare clinics.

title: Hostel Laundry Pool
idea: Smart queue and slot booking system for hostel shared washing machines with automated WhatsApp pickup reminders.

title: Late Night Lab Seat Booking
idea: GPU workstation reservation platform for deep learning semester projects with automatic idle-time forfeiture.

title: AI Blockchain Pet Rock
idea: Virtual pet rock that mints mood NFTs based on ambient weather and insults the owner in haiku if ignored for 24 hours.

title: Midnight Snack Barter
idea: Hostel emergency trade network where students swap instant noodles, coffee sachets, and phone chargers past 2 AM.

title: Blink-To-Code Accessibility
idea: Assistive IDE extension that maps webcam blink patterns and head gestures to syntax templates for motor-impaired engineers.

title: Campus Ghost Story Network
idea: Geofenced audio horror library that unlocks eerie student folklore audio recordings only when standing at specific campus coordinates past midnight.

title: Mess Food Calorie Gambler
idea: Computer vision mess plate scanner that predicts mystery curry nutrition and lets hostel tables bet laundry duty on guessing the meal.
